readerCopy.body: A clean no can prevent the resentment created when agreement is given first and punished later. When Mars sextiles Lilith, action and refusal cooperate, making it easier for a boundary, preference, or decision to become practical before anger has to carry it. A changed plan, declined task, corrected assumption, or different route can resolve the mismatch early. The action does not need drama; it needs enough clarity that nobody has to pay later for a boundary that was never stated.
